verse.verse_3: Would that you knew what the Clatterer is!
verse.verse_4: [It is] a Day when mankind shall be like scattered moths
verse.verse_5: and the mount-ains like tufts of carded wool.
verse.verse_6: Then, the one whose good deeds weigh heavy on the scales,
verse.verse_7: will have a most pleasing life.
verse.verse_8: But as for him whose deeds are light on the scales,
verse.verse_9: the Abyss shall be his home.
verse.verse_10: What will convey to you what this is like?
